quotes.text: His music is distinguished by its positive, ear-catching tunes that are known to get people moving.
Rosin's music is sometimes said to as upbeat and contagious, and his use of upbeat rhythms and memorable melodies makes his songs popular with listeners of all ages.
He has received accolades for his ability to capture the essence of Schlager music while merging it with his own special style to produce a mix of both new and recognizable sounds.
Rosin's songs are well-liked for their likable melodies, amusing lyrics, and bouncy rhythms that inspire listeners of all ages to dance and sing along.
His talent for writing enticing and enjoyable melodies shows off in his recent singles and demonstrates his continued ability to produce entertaining music that is appealing to both kids and adults.
Rosin has displayed his aptitude for producing energetic and danceable Schlager music across festivals like Schlagermove Festival and Potsdamer Schlossernacht.
His capacity for writing entertaining and captivating songs has earned him a devoted following in the Schlager music community.
From 1982, he released one record a year, as well as the accompanying songbooks, establishing a prolific pattern of pairing musical recordings with educational materials.
In the 1990s, Oldies für Kinder and Heut ist Partytime, two CDs with cover versions of oldies from forty years of pop history, were released to connect adults and children across generations.
In 2015, Volker Rosin releases his first jazz album for children, Der blaue Hund will tanzen (The Blue Dog Wants to Dance), expanding his creative palette into the jazz idiom.
